english.title: Print/publish newspaper advert re: election candidate without printer/publisher/promoter details
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[promoter of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of a candidate, namely **(..SPECiFY CANDIDATE..), at an election, namely **(SPECIFY ELECTION..), and which was published in an advertisement contained in a newspaper or periodical, namely **(..SPECIFY NEWSPAPER OR PERIODICAL..),]_
(B)_[publisher of material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), and was in an advertisement contained in a newspaper or periodical, namely **(..SPECIFY NEWSPAPER OR PERIODICAL..),]_
(C)_[printer of an advertisement in a newspaper or periodical, namely **(..SPECIFY NEWSPAPER OR PERIODICAL..),which contained material which could reasonably be regarded as intended to promote or procure the election of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..),]_

when the name and address of

(D)_[the printer of that newspaper or periodical did not appear on its first or last page]_
(E)_[the promoter of the material was not included in the advertisement]_
(F)_[a person on behalf of whom the material was being published was not included in the advertisement]_
(G)_[**(..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF ABOVE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 110(2)(a), (6) and (9) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see section 176

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
